import zipfile
import re
import shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w')

for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        xml = data.decode('utf-8')
        # 1. Update dimension range A1:G10 -> A1:H10
        xml = xml.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')
        # 2. Add a column definition for H (width 15)
        xml = xml.replace(
            '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
            '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="15" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>'
        )
        # 3. Header cell H1 (header style s="1")
        xml = xml.replace(
            '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
            '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
            '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>'
        )
        # 4. Data rows 2-9: margin = Profit / Revenue = G/E, percent style s="3"
        def add_h(m):
            r = m.group(1)
            return m.group(0) + '<c r="H%s" s="3"><f>G%s/E%s</f><v></v></c>' % (r, r, r)
        xml = re.sub(r'<c r="G([2-9])"><f>E\1-C\1\*F\1</f><v></v></c>', add_h, xml)
        # 5. TOTAL row: aggregate margin = total profit / total revenue
        xml = xml.replace(
            '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>',
            '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
            '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>'
        )
        data = xml.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        xml = data.decode('utf-8')
        # Add a custom 0.0% percentage number format
        xml = xml.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
                          '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
        # Add a 4th cell style (index 3) using that format
        xml = xml.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">')
        xml = xml.replace(
            '</cellXfs>',
            '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
        )
        data = xml.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)

zout.close()
zin.close()
shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('OK: sales_data.xlsx updated')
PYEOF
